_comment: Hand-curated layer of docs/capabilities.json, built the way stapel-core's is (stapel_tools.surface: `make contract`). This library has no Django settings namespace of axes and no HTTP surface, so axes is empty and operations_total is absent; the surface entry set is derived from surface_roots by AST, and a selected symbol without an intent line fails the build.
provides: Production secret storage behind the stapel_core.secrets provider seam: VaultSecretProvider reads secrets from OpenBao / HashiCorp Vault KV v2 (token, kubernetes or approle auth, fail-closed, bundle cache, versioned reads), configurable from the environment so it works before Django settings load.

extension_points.name: STAPEL_SECRETS_PROVIDER
extension_points.summary: The stapel-core secrets seam this library implements: set it to stapel_vault.VaultSecretProvider in the control-plane process (never inside a workload container) to read secrets from Vault instead of the environment.

extension_points.name: VAULT_SECRET_MAP
extension_points.summary: Per-name location override ({"NAME": "<path>#<key>"}) for a secret that does not live in the service bundle at <KV_MOUNT>/data/<SECRET_PATH_PREFIX>/<SECRET_APP>.

load_config.intent: The resolved VaultConfig (STAPEL_VAULT when Django is configured, else the VAULT_* environment, else defaults; keyword overrides win) — build one here rather than reading the variables yourself, so a tool and the provider agree on address, mount and auth.

map_name.intent: Where a logical secret name lives in KV v2 (mount, path, key) under a config, honouring SECRET_MAP — the one mapping rule, for a tool that writes or audits the secrets the provider will read.

requires.reason: the stapel_core.secrets provider seam this library plugs into (resolution, caching, fail-closed SecretUnavailable)
